title: Users & roles
subtitle: Accounts, role assignment and access review

governance.heading: Governance on this surface
governance.rls: Row Level Security limits the roster before it reaches this page.
governance.audit: Every write is re-checked on the server and appends audit evidence.
governance.effect: Changes take effect on the user's next authorized request.
governance.readOnly: This session can read the roster but cannot change access.

roster.caption: Accounts visible to your session
roster.emptyTitle: No accounts are visible to your session
roster.emptyBody: Row Level Security filters this roster. Accounts outside your visibility are absent, not hidden.

catalogue.title: Role catalogue
catalogue.body: Only roles visible to your session through Row Level Security are listed.
catalogue.emptyTitle: No roles are visible to your session
catalogue.emptyBody: The role catalogue is filtered by Row Level Security.

manage.title: Access management
manage.intro: Grant or revoke roles and direct capability overrides.
manage.noUsers: No account is available to manage
manage.noGrantableRoles: This user already holds every visible role
manage.confirmRevokeRole: Revoke the role “{name}” from this user? The change is recorded and takes effect on their next request.
manage.confirmGrantAdminRole: Grant the administrator role “{name}” to this user? This gives them admin-level access and is recorded.
manage.confirmRevokeCapability: Revoke the direct capability override “{name}” from this user? Role-derived access is unaffected.
manage.capabilitiesHint: Capabilities derived from this user's roles, plus direct grant overrides, each labelled with its source.
manage.noGrantableCapabilities: This user already holds every direct override
manage.noCapabilities: This user currently has no effective capabilities — no roles and no direct grants.
manage.selfTarget: This is your own account. The self-escalation guard refuses access changes you make to yourself — another administrator must make them.
manage.saved: Saved — effective on the user's next request

roleCaps.title: Role capabilities
roleCaps.intro: Grant or revoke a capability for an entire role. A capability you do not hold cannot be granted to a role you hold, and access management can never be granted to or revoked from your own role.
roleCaps.noRoles: No role is available to manage
roleCaps.noGrants: This role currently has no capability grants.
roleCaps.noGrantableCapabilities: This role already holds every capability
roleCaps.confirmRevoke: Revoke “{permission}” from every user with role “{role}”? The change takes effect on their next request.
roleCaps.confirmGrantSod: Grant the separation-of-duties capability to role “{role}”? Any holder of that role could then change access.

denied.title: Access management is restricted
denied.body: This screen requires the administrator role. Your session does not hold it, so nothing here is shown rather than hidden.

error.title: Access management could not be loaded
error.body: No account, role or permission was changed. Retry, or quote the reference below to support.
error.rosterTitle: The user roster could not be read
error.rosterBody: Nothing was changed. Reload the page to try again.
error.rolesBody: The roster remains visible, but role labels and every access change are unavailable.
error.permissionsBody: Every write control is turned off until your access-management permission can be read again.
error.manageBody: The roster remains visible, but one or more approved sources could not be read.
error.catalogueTitle: The role catalogue could not be read
error.catalogueBody: No role controls are available on this view.
error.roleCapsBody: The role catalogue remains visible, but an approved source could not be read.
